needed.evidence: The left side has no continuous, purpose-built sidewalk; the path is an informal, snow-covered strip between the parked cars and the trees.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway on the left side, separating the pedestrian path from the parking lane.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the left is obstructed by a line of parked vehicles, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them.
needed.suggestion: Implement a no-parking zone or designated parking bays on the left to keep the pedestrian path clear.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the left is uneven and covered in packed snow and ice, creating significant trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Ensure the footway is properly graded and maintained to prevent snow and ice accumulation.

needed.evidence: The right-side sidewalk is uneven and has large, irregular piles of snow, creating trip hazards for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Install a proper kerb and ensure the sidewalk is cleared and maintained to a safe standard.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to residential and commercial properties on both sides, but no formal crossing facility is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at a logical point, such as near the building entrances on the right.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users.
